products.title: Solar Proposal Decoder
products.author: Casey Rowan
products.status_note: RN5-001 v1.1 rebuilt at selected 8 x 10 trim after a three-format same-content comparison; 57 PDF pages, 58 KDP pages, awaiting human cover and publishing gate.
production_learnings: TRIM SIZE IS A PRODUCT DECISION, NOT A DEFAULT PRODUCTION SETTING.
The 8 x 10 trim preserves readable 10.9 pt body type and about 1.75-inch answer cells while avoiding the thin office-manual feel of 8.5 x 11.
Callout spacing and chapter-end whitespace need deterministic regression gates in addition to technical preflight.

evidence.summary: The initial 8.5 x 11 release passed technical QA but had not validated physical-product fit, trim alternatives, semantic spacing or chapter-end whitespace.

details.reusable_rule: TRIM SIZE IS A PRODUCT DECISION, NOT A DEFAULT PRODUCTION SETTING.

evidence.summary: RN5-001 v1.1 rebuilt at 8 x 10 with explicit callout spacing, asymmetric writable forms, non-forced part transitions and deterministic format-layout QA.

decisions.reason: The same-content comparison showed that 8 x 10 best balances printed readability, writable width, page density, physical feel and unchanged large-trim economics.
